subject: Data Engineering
title: Full Extraction
description: A quick win: understand Full Extraction.

hook.text: The simplest extract pattern: copy everything from the source every single time.

buildup.text: Full extraction grabs the entire dataset — every row, every field — regardless of what changed.

discovery.text: It's easy to implement and guarantees you never miss a change. Zero bookkeeping required.

twist.text: As data grows, full extraction becomes painfully slow and expensive. Copying a billion rows nightly adds up.

climax.text: Full extraction works for small, slow-changing datasets. Beyond that, incremental is the way.

punchline.text: Copy everything — simple until it's not.

quiz.question: What is the main drawback of full extraction?
options: It becomes slow and expensive as data grows
